# Stargate

> Stargate is a cross-chain bridge built on LayerZero that moves stablecoins and ETH between chains using unified liquidity pools. This page is a non-custodial interface: you connect your own wallet and sign every transaction. It explains how the bridge works, fees and safety checks.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Stargate is a cross-chain bridge built on LayerZero.
- It moves stablecoins and ETH between chains using unified liquidity pools.
- Fees combine source-chain gas, a protocol fee and a messaging fee shown in the quote.
- Large transfers can be limited by liquidity in the destination pool.
- The interface is non-custodial and never holds funds or private keys.

- Stargate & learn: https://stargate-app.github.io/
- Legal: https://stargate-app.github.io/legal.html
